_comment: The 25 most-learned scripted moves that Core runs by hand (plus Struggle, which is a rule of the game, and which no Pokémon learns), and the shared conditions that Core runs for any move (chapter 19.6, phase 46). tools/effect-coverage.mjs and the Java MoveBook both read this file. A scripted move is 'implemented' when it is listed under moves, or when it has no code and every condition it sets is listed under conditions.
